verdict.rationale: Jan documents a local OpenAI-compatible API server and per-call MCP tool approval, but nothing in the evidence shows it can issue API keys or credentials, let alone scoped or least-privilege ones for an agent. Per-call tool approval is an adjacent control, not credential scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
